title: ECE Licensing Criteria — Centre-based Services
description: The licensing criteria centre-based ECE services must meet, covering premises, health and safety, staffing and curriculum requirements.

title: ERO: Early Learning Curriculum
description: Education Review Office guidance on curriculum quality in early learning services, used to inform internal evaluation and review.

title: Education and Training Act 2020
description: The principal legislation governing education in New Zealand, including the legal framework for licensed early childhood services.

title: National Education and Learning Priorities (NELP)
description: The Government’s priorities for education, which licensed ECE services are required to give effect to in their planning and practice.

title: He Māpuna te Tamaiti
description: Practical strategies for supporting social and emotional competence and positive behaviour in early learning settings.

title: Kōwhiti Whakapae — Using the Framework
description: Guidance on using the Kōwhiti Whakapae progress tools to notice, recognise and respond to children’s learning.

title: Our Code, Our Standards — Ngā Tikanga Matatika, Ngā Paerewa
description: The Teaching Council’s code of professional responsibility and standards for the teaching profession.

title: School Evaluation Indicators
description: ERO evaluation indicators describing what effective practice looks like, and the evidence used when reviewing a service.

title: He Māpuna te Tamaiti — Self-Assessment Tool
description: The companion self-assessment tool teachers use to reflect on their own practice against He Māpuna te Tamaiti.

title: Tapasā: Cultural Competencies Framework for Teachers of Pacific Learners
description: Framework supporting teachers to be culturally responsive to Pacific learners, their parents, families and communities.

title: Tātaiako: Cultural Competencies for Teachers of Māori Learners
description: Cultural competencies framework supporting teachers to work effectively with Māori learners and their whānau.

title: Te Whāriki: Early Childhood Curriculum
description: The national early childhood curriculum for Aotearoa New Zealand, setting out the principles, strands and learning outcomes that underpin ECE practice.
